<thought>We need to determine the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule. The only way to get structural information is to retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample, then count the distinct carbon signals that fall within the typical aromatic carbon chemical shift range (≈110–160 ppm). This will give the count of aromatic carbons.</thought>
